//: Copy to ~/.config/omp-discord/config.json (or set OMP_BOT_CONFIG). Discord: User Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode, then right-click → Copy ID. Keys that start with // are comments.
//channels: Text channels that start agent runs: channel id → name and working folder.
//alertChannels: Post-only channels (the loopback /post endpoint can write there; messages never start runs).
//firstmateChannelId: Channel of the main coordinating session (FIRSTMATE). Usually a mirrored Herdr channel; spoken turns and Shortcut prompts go here.
//needsYouChannelId: Optional post-only channel that keeps one live ✍️ Needs you board (FIRSTMATE cards waiting on the owner) as its last message. Also list it in alertChannels. Empty: off.
//localModelChannelId: Optional channel whose owner messages go only to a local llama.cpp model (src/localmodel.ts). Empty: off.
//localOmpChannelId: Optional channel whose owner messages run one OMP turn with the local model and tools (src/localomp.ts). Empty: off.
//localOmpTools: Tools for that channel. Default read,grep,glob,write,edit (writes only in ~/discord-scratch/local-omp). Add ,bash to allow commands; they still run in the bwrap sandbox.
//localOmpChannelIds: More local-omp channels (same handler, own session and work dir each). localOmpChannelId is always included.
//mirror: Herdr tab ↔ Discord channel mirror. Empty local category turns mirroring off. peers: an optional second machine reached over ssh (alias from ~/.ssh/config).

mirror.//overflow: More category ids for this machine's live pane channels, used in order when the local category holds 50 channels.

//dashboardUrl: FIRSTMATE dashboard base URL that your phone can open, e.g. https://<host>.<tailnet>.ts.net/reports/firstmate/ . Empty: replies carry no dashboard link.
//fmDir: Dashboard folder (items.json + web files). Must match FM_DIR in ~/.config/omp-discord/kit.env.
//heeler: Optional: HEELER iOS app links. redirect = your deployed heeler-link worker (https://…/open). Empty: no buttons.
//optionalCommands: Owner-specific slash commands; leave empty unless you have the matching hardware/accounts: rgb, nest, blinds, positions, newsletter, stream, second.
//router: FIRSTMATE fan-out router (src/router.ts): owner messages in the FIRSTMATE channel go to a domain stack thread (rules, then the JEV judge). channelIds: topic channels whose jobs carry that stack's tag. Omit the key for the defaults (on, 4 stacks in parallel).
